column1: # `respelled`: the program in scripts/test7/respelled/<path> replaces the frozen original in the corpus (the tarball
# keeps the original); it is today's spelling of the same unsafe pattern, so it reaches the probed hole again.
# A `respelled` row whose note starts "header only" changes nothing but the `// expect:` line: the language made the
# probed program sound to accept, and the note gives the evidence (the neighbouring unsafe variants it still rejects).
# `kept`: not respelled, because the stopping diagnostic is the probed hole or its wall under another code, the shape
# has no spelling in today's language, or the frozen probe never reached a shape.
